changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Restricciones CHECK del catalogo de roles
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE cat_rol ADD CONSTRAINT ck_cat_rol_role_code CHECK (role_code IN ('EMPLEADO','TECNICO_MANTENIMIENTO','ADMINISTRADOR'))
ALTER TABLE cat_rol ADD CONSTRAINT ck_cat_rol_is_active CHECK (is_active IN ('Y','N'))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE cat_rol DROP CONSTRAINT ck_cat_rol_role_code
ALTER TABLE cat_rol DROP CONSTRAINT ck_cat_rol_is_active

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Restricciones CHECK del catalogo de operaciones
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE cat_operacion ADD CONSTRAINT ck_cat_operacion_code CHECK (operation_code IN ('INCIDENT_CREATE','INCIDENT_LIST_OWN','INCIDENT_LIST_ALL','INCIDENT_VIEW','INCIDENT_HISTORY_VIEW','INCIDENT_ASSIGN_SELF','INCIDENT_STATUS_CHANGE','INCIDENT_CLOSE_WITH_COMMENT','USER_MANAGE'))
ALTER TABLE cat_operacion ADD CONSTRAINT ck_cat_operacion_is_active CHECK (is_active IN ('Y','N'))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE cat_operacion DROP CONSTRAINT ck_cat_operacion_code
ALTER TABLE cat_operacion DROP CONSTRAINT ck_cat_operacion_is_active

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Matriz de permisos rol-operacion con PK compuesta (role_code, operation_code)
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE permiso_rol_operacion ( permiso_id NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, role_code VARCHAR2(32 CHAR) NOT NULL, operation_code VARCHAR2(50 CHAR) NOT NULL, data_scope VARCHAR2(10 CHAR) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_permiso_rol_operacion PRIMARY KEY (role_code, operation_code), CONSTRAINT uk_permiso_rol_operacion_id UNIQUE (permiso_id), CONSTRAINT ck_permiso_data_scope CHECK (data_scope IN ('OWN','ALL')), CONSTRAINT fk_permiso_role_code FOREIGN KEY (role_code) REFERENCES cat_rol (role_code), CONSTRAINT fk_permiso_operation_code FOREIGN KEY (operation_code) REFERENCES cat_operacion (operation_code) )
